constraints.description: Do not bind the detector to fixed file paths, line numbers, or exact patch strings.

constraints.description: Keep the detector focused on the vulnerability family implied by the patch and evidence.

constraints.title: Respect analyzer-native form

constraints.description: Generalize only along evidence-supported semantic dimensions. Do not broaden the detector into unrelated globals, APIs, or bug families.

constraints.title: Honor mechanism contract
constraints.description: Preserve the mechanism family `arithmetic_bound_violation` by keeping trigger invariants size/count arithmetic feeds a sensitive sink such as allocation, indexing, or copy length; the path lacks a proof that the arithmetic stays within the intended range; Patch-backed trigger clue: added or highlighted APIs: kcalloc.

constraints.title: Generalize only on contract axes
constraints.description: Reuse semantics only along these transfer axes: equivalent arithmetic-to-sink relationships on sibling code paths; equivalent range guards for the same size/count role; equivalent guard or barrier predicates on sibling paths.

constraints.title: Encode the patch-added barrier
constraints.description: model the absence of barriers like overflow-safe accumulator; use APIs such as kcalloc as semantic clues, not string matches.

constraints.title: Respect patched silence
constraints.description: Use these no-report conditions when they are semantically proven: patch-introduced barrier pattern: overflow-safe accumulator.

constraints.title: Tie arithmetic to the sensitive sink
constraints.description: Do not flag standalone arithmetic; require a range-unsafe expression to feed allocation, indexing, copy length, or an equivalent sensitive sink.

constraints.title: Use path-sensitive evidence
constraints.description: Prefer guards, state transitions, and lifecycle facts over broad textual matching.

constraints.title: No placeholder helper logic
constraints.description: Helper predicates must inspect AST/program state and must not be unconditional return-true/return-false stubs.
